notes: Declarant is a local-first customs clearing workspace for a Mombasa freight desk. It covers intake, document checklists with lodgement gates, pro-rata CIF allocation, duty/excise/VAT/levy computation, assessments, customs queries, release and delivery, disbursement aging, client statements, CSV exports, print documents and role-based demo accounts. Runs directly from index.html with seeded data and localStorage persistence; no server, build step or external services. Limitations: tariff rates and the demo accounts are illustrative and not a substitute for current authority tariffs or real authentication; data is confined to one browser profile; CSV and print output are the only integrations; the bundled test suite covers core calculations, document gating, aging and storage serialisation, not browser rendering.
